title: Mint crypto
text: Black: the bank pays 1,000K. Red: pay 100K.

title: Crypto scams
text: Red: pay 500K. Black: the bank pays 500K.

title: ChatGPT
text: Black: lose your job. Red: the bank pays 500K.

title: Lawsuit, tomatoes
text: A player pays you 100K.

title: Lawsuit, stolen idea
text: A player pays you 100K.

title: Lawsuit, damaged property
text: A player pays you 100K.

title: Lucky Moose
text: Spin the wheel. This prize is 1,000K.

title: Goat ribbon
text: The bank pays you 120K. Keep this card.

title: Food truck
text: Highest spin wins 500K. Ties all win.

title: Spin to lose
text: Highest spin pays 500K. Ties all pay.

title: Dog ransom
text: Spin and pay 10K, 20K, 50K, or 100K.

title: Movie star
text: Spin. The ends pay or collect. A 9 or 10 pays 5,000K.

title: Mugged
text: Black: you fight it off. Red: your cash is 0.

title: Robbed by the right
text: The player on your right takes your cash and loans. Skip a turn.

title: Steal from the left
text: Take all cash and loans from the player on your left.

title: Identity theft
text: Swap lives with another player. Seats stay put.

title: Five-loan hobby
text: Take 5 loans.

title: Double salary
text: Your printed salary is doubled.

title: Salary flip
text: Red: salary 0. Black: salary 1,000K.

title: House collector
text: Spin. Steal 0, 1, or 2 houses.

title: Love it or list it
text: Buy up to two houses for 200K cash each.

title: Steal a job or a house
text: Take one job or one house.

title: Foreclosure
text: Lose every house, or your children if you have no house.

title: Free star
text: Invest in an empty star for free.

title: Life toll
text: Later stars cost 600K.

title: Nigel
text: Go to the Macaw space and take 3 loans.

title: Win a car
text: Gain a car, or 60K if you are at your cap.

title: Car flip
text: Lose a car, or gain one if you have none.

title: Insurance flip
text: Lose your policy, or gain one for free.

title: Unpaid insurance
text: Lose a car. Odd spins are halved from now on.

title: Flat tire
text: Subtract 2 for three turns. Below 0, pay 250K.

title: Giraffe
text: Your car stops on every Payday.

title: E-bike
text: Trade your car for an e-bike. +2 to every move.

title: EV
text: Your car is an EV. +1 to every move. No car: gain one.

title: Steal every car
text: Each other player loses one car. You gain up to your cap.

title: Move 10
text: For three turns, move 10 spaces and do not spin.

title: Jet
text: Double speed for two turns if you have a car and no double yet.

title: Fired, cat
text: Draw two jobs from your deck and keep one.

title: Fired, snooze
text: Draw two jobs from your deck and keep one.

title: Fired forever
text: You cannot take a job. Snakebite can still make you Bee Keeper.

title: Adoption
text: Gain a girl and move back 10.

title: Twelve children
text: Gain 8 girls and 4 boys. Move -4 while any remain.

title: Kidnapping
text: Pay 10K per child. Red: they are gone. Black: they stay.

title: Vows
text: Black: lose your spouse. Red: pay 100K and keep them.

title: Divorce fight
text: Lose spouse and children. Jail key 4, unless you are a Firefighter.

title: Lost phone
text: Move back 6.

title: Night school
text: Go to Night School and pay the fee.

title: Polar bear
text: Retreat to the space before a star.

title: COVID
text: Red: skip 3 turns. Black: skip 1 turn.

title: Broken leg
text: Draw no actions for 5 turns.

title: Left hand
text: Spin with your left hand for the rest of the game.

title: Groundhog
text: Stay until you spin black.

title: Meat
text: If you ate meat in the last 24 hours, your cash becomes 0.

title: Hogwarts
text: Draw two actions and keep one.

title: Draw two
text: Action draws are two cards for the rest of the game.

title: Wheel
text: Spin the wheel on the current pot.

title: Bacteria
text: Cling to the player on your left and move when they move.

title: Break free
text: Leave the bacteria pair, jump one space, and draw an action.

title: Star immunity
text: Ignore star costs and other players' targeted actions.

title: Roadkill blessing
text: The five spaces behind you are Roadkill for everyone else.

title: Roadkill expands
text: The space before Roadkill is also Roadkill.

title: Snakebite
text: Become Bee Keeper. The previous Bee Keeper is fired forever.
